descriptor.name: Netherlands Kadaster / PDOK cadastral map
descriptor.scope: National Dutch cadastral map; bounded Amsterdam and Rotterdam globe entries are enabled. Valid (G) records only. Boundaries are indicative and unsuitable for survey measurements or establishing legal title.
